rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is confirmed or observed by unaided sight rather than by an instrument or system.

example.english: You can't see these bacteria visually.
example.traditional: 呢啲細菌用肉眼睇唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 sai3 kwan2 jung6 juk6 ngaan5 tai2 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that someone personally saw it with their own eyes.

example.english: I visually witnessed him take the document away.
example.traditional: 我親眼見到佢攞走份文件。
example.jyutping: ngo5 can1 ngaan5 gin3 dou2 keoi5 lo2 zau2 fan6 man4 gin2
